notes: Counts match the 151-piece parts list: every type/colour appears exactly as many times as listed.
Parts-list element 6271540 (shown on the manual's parts page) is taken as lego-57360 hinge cylinder (list element 6615540).
Step 2 red tiles are 2x3 (lego-26603); step 8 red tiles are 2x4 grooved (lego-87079 red). Notched 3x2/4x2 wedges were taken as 'Left' and plain ones as 'Right'.

The four 4x12 plates (b1, b10, b12, b24) sit side by side at the same level and are tied together by the black 2x4 tiles above them (b9, b11, b23 bridge the plates); b10, b12 and b24 therefore clutch nothing below and have [] rests_on. b23 lists b24 although b24 is added later.

Correction: nothing is listed as resting on a tile any more (tiles have no studs). Pieces that visually cover tiles (b34/b35, b44-b48, b52-b56, b61/b62, b72/b73, b77, b110, b113/b114) now rest only on the plates/studded pieces beneath or beside the tiles. The two round tiles b39/b40 stay on the red 4x4 plates; the swivel hinge plates b72/b73 are placed on the red 4x4 and white wedge beside them.
The booklet shows no coordinates and many rests_on lists beyond the first layers (face/helmet layers, backing frame, stand) are best-effort estimates from the isometric pictures.
Steps 27-34 build the back frame/stand on the flipped model; step 35 flips it back. The stand parts b88-b94 are a separate sub-assembly joined only via hinges/axles, so they have [] rests_on.
The 'x' parts boxes were expanded per copy (steps 40 and 41 each build one shoulder sub-assembly; steps 33/34 build four corner feet).
